prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high-endurance athlete requiring 3000+ calories with carbohydrate loading and strategic hydration

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrates (55-65% of total intake)
Includes 4-5 eating occasions with hydration timing specified before, during, and after training
Compact format with clear meal times and portion sizes suitable for single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration timing throughout the day

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and muscle gains for powerlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4-5 meals with protein distributed across each meal (minimum 30g per meal)
Includes specific pre-workout meal (1-2 hours before) and post-workout meal (within 30-60 minutes after) with appropriate macronutrient timing
Total daily protein intake aligns with strength athlete needs (approximately 1.7-2.2g per kg bodyweight)
All food items accommodate lactose intolerance restriction
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing precise protein distribution across meals and specific pre/post-workout nutrition windows

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain performance and muscle recovery for soccer training

solution_criteria: Includes complete protein sources at each meal (legumes, tofu, nuts, seeds, or grains combined)
Contains iron-rich plant-based foods with vitamin C sources to enhance absorption
Provides adequate calories and macronutrients for athletic performance
Meal plan is compact and covers one full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
